address: Burj Khalifa, 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Boulevard, Dubai
bio: Sleek, modern and minimalistic, with impressive views of the fountains, as well as plenty of culinary theatrics at the sushi, robatayaki and teppanyaki counters are found in this restaurant located inside the Burj Khalifa’s Armani Hotel. The contemporary Japanese dishes use first class ingredients flown in from Japan. Go for one of the omakase or kaiseki menus....
